references.text: God commands Moses to gather the people at Sinai to hear His words, so that they may learn to fear Him.
The people stood and watched as God spoke, and Moses explained that God had come to test them, so that the fear of Him would remain upon them.
The purpose of the commandments is that Israel should fear the Lord all their days, both they themselves and their children.
The command to teach God's words to one's children and speak of them at every opportunity.
Israel is commanded to teach their children God's words and speak of them at home and abroad.
The people are to gather to hear the law, learn it, and fear the Lord, and even the children who do not know it must also learn to fear the Lord.
The psalmist offers to teach others to fear the Lord, which is the foundation of wisdom.
Fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, linking to the purpose of teaching God's words.
Hebrews refers to Israel's experience at Sinai/Horeb, where the people stood before God and heard His voice.
